<!--
Merging to `main` deploys to the gateways within about fifteen minutes. Say what
changes for a gateway, in a sentence or two, and fill in what applies below.
Delete the section that does not.
-->

## What changes for a gateway

## Every change

- [ ] `test` and `guard-scan` are green on this branch.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased when behaviour changes.
- [ ] A new capability or manifest key is claimed only where it can be honoured, and `plugin.yaml` and `contract.py` agree.
- [ ] State changes bump `STATE_VERSION` and come with a migration and a test.
- [ ] Nothing here adds a listener, a route, an outbound request or a stored secret that the description does not name.
- [ ] A change to the workflows, `scripts/guard_scan.py` or `.github/scanner-pins.json` says why, and was read as a change to the supply chain.

## Importing a web client bundle

Only for a pull request that touches `dashboard/app/`. Everything under that
folder is generated by the app repository's build and is reviewed here against
this list, not line by line. A bundle pull request contains nothing else.

- [ ] The diff touches only `dashboard/app/**`, the version in `plugin.yaml` and in `contract.py`, and `CHANGELOG.md`. No Python, no workflow, no pins.
- [ ] `dashboard/app/build.json` names the app repository, a full 40-character source commit and the client version, and the commit is on that repository's `main`.
- [ ] The version is higher than the one on `main`, `plugin.yaml` and `contract.py` agree, and the changelog says which client build this is.
- [ ] `web-bundle-verify` is green: the bundle is the rebuild of that commit, byte for byte. (While it is the placeholder, a bundle does not pass: do not merge.)
- [ ] `guard-scan` is green on this branch, with the bundle in the tree.
- [ ] The script that did the import (`scripts/import_web_client.py`) printed the same version, commit, file count and size as `build.json`; paste its output here.
- [ ] No file is new in kind: nothing but the extensions the dashboard allow-list names, no source maps, no unexplained file over the size limits.
- [ ] A reviewer other than the author has gone through this list and approved the pull request.

Rolling back a bundle is a revert of the import commit on `main`; nothing else
needs to change.
